 Or
% 09.07.2024
1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of Fir No.422/2022 Ps Pul Prahladpur under Sections
498A/406/34 Ipc on the basis of settlement dated 03rd April, 2024 arrived at between the parties,
which is on record of the Court.
2.  The marriage of the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 was solemnised on 25th May, 2022 and due to discord the divorce has been obtained by decree dated 15th May, 2024.
There is no child borne out of wedlock.

3. As per the settlement, an amount of Rs.5 Lacs has already been paid during the divorce proceedings and the balance amount of Rs.10 Lacs is being tendered today vide DD No.678300 drawn on State Bank of India dated 29th June, 2024, which is received by respondent No.2 in Court and
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/07/2024 at 02:31:08 duly acknowledged.

Petitioners are present in Court and duly identified by the IO except for petitioner Nos.4 and 9 who are appearing through VC and petitioner No.3 who is not available because she is paralysed and is exempted.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.422/2022 PS Pul Prahladpur under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
